title: Diagonal Isoduality and Transversal Clifford Groups of MDS–CSS Codes
description: For an odd-prime linear [2m,m,m+1]_q MDS code, this preprint proves that the diagonal code-to-dual multiplier space has dimension zero or one and exactly selects the projective transversal logical group: F_q²⋊SL₂(q) on the diagonally isodual branch and F_q²⋊T otherwise. Stabilizer-AME rigidity supplies the factorwise-Clifford converse; coherent Weil lifts and the Heisenberg obstruction delimit linear from affine splitting. For six coordinates, self-association gives the conic boundary and one degree-eight quotient classifies an explicit non-GRS pencil.
